utils/debounce.name: debounce
utils/debounce.description: Creates a debounced version of a function to delay invocation until after wait milliseconds.
utils/debounce.aiPromptContext: Use this block when handling rapid, repetitive events such as search input keystrokes, window resizing, or scroll events to avoid calling heavy handlers too frequently.

parameters.name: options.immediate
parameters.description: Trigger the function on the leading edge.

web/fetch-retry.name: fetch-retry
web/fetch-retry.description: A resilient fetch wrapper supporting retries, delay backoff, and request timeouts.
web/fetch-retry.aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to make HTTP requests that are resilient to temporary network failures or rate limits (returns 5xx status codes). Avoid writing raw fetch loops manually. Import using: import { fetchRetry } from './utils/fetchRetry.js';

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The destination URL for the HTTP request.

parameters.name: options.retries
parameters.description: Maximum number of retries before failing.

parameters.name: options.delay
parameters.description: Base delay for backoff in milliseconds.

parameters.name: options.timeout
parameters.description: Abort request after this timeout in milliseconds.
